note: No public queryable parcel service found for Mayes County OK. The county GIS viewer (lmweb.dyndns.org:6580/Mapview-Mayes) returns 502/connection errors, including on its arcgis/rest/services path. The county site offers only static PDF maps; the assessor records portal is a vendor site. The Oklahoma statewide parcel layer is view-only WMS, not downloadable or queryable as features, and Mayes is not listed. Other parcel sources (Regrid, Dynamo Spatial, Mapping Solutions GIS, Acres) are paid commercial products.
